instruction: I want to enable colorized output for ls commands automatically. Could you add the appropriate alias to my shell configuration so that ls always uses the --color=auto option?

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)
